item.title: Madison County primary results are in
item.description: Madison County primary results are in News Staff Tue, 03/03/2026 - 21:35 In-page image(s) Body Madison County voters decided four contested Republican primary races Tuesday, with two incumbents winning reelection, one losing his seat and a new justice of the peace chosen for an open bench.Thomas Collard defeated incumbent Precinct 2 Commissioner Carl Wiseman with 295 votes to Wiseman’s 226, taking 56.62 percent of ballots cast. The results are unofficial.County Clerk Adrian Lawson won reelection
